card.name: Word right after a count or article
card.fires_on: The word right after a number or a small determiner such as 'A', 'No' or 'One', often a unit or noun like 'capsule' or 'case', or a split-off piece of a longer word. Seen mostly in dosage and overdosage sections.

modes.label: Noun after a count
modes.description: A unit or noun directly after 1, No or One in dose or overdose statements.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of dutasteride and tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules is 1<< capsule>> (0.5 mg dutasteride

modes.label: Split-up words after A
modes.description: A piece of a word or acronym broken apart right after the letter A.
modes.example: A<< C>>YP-mediated drug interaction effect was not observed

modes.label: Inside numbers and units
modes.description: A digit or unit piece inside a number or measurement.
